name: Customer Support Day 0
description: A brand-new agent with only a name. No instructions, guidelines, or skills. Shows the clean slate a user sees right after creating their first agent.

helperMessages.content: I want to build a customer support agent for my e-commerce store.

Great idea! A customer support agent can handle common inquiries so your team can focus on complex issues.

To get started, let me ask a few questions:

1. **Who are your customers?** (e.g. general consumers, business buyers, a specific segment)
2. **What types of questions come up most often?** (order status, returns, product info, billing?)
3. **Do you want the agent to take actions** — like looking up orders or initiating returns — or just answer questions?

The more I know about your support needs, the better I can help you shape this agent.
